name: Prin. L. N. Welingkar Institute of Management Development & Research (WeSchool), Mumbai

programs.name: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM)
programs.feeNote: PGDM 2026-28 brochure: tuition fee INR 7,00,000 per annum (subject to change); total shown is 2 x per-annum tuition. Excludes library deposit INR 4,000 (refundable) and hostel. The current PGDM web page (batch not stated, likely 2027-29) shows tuition fees & other INR 7,50,000 p.a.*, hostel INR 1,60,000-2,20,000 p.a. + INR 10,000 refundable deposit (Mumbai hostel subject to availability).
programs.intakeNote: PGDM 2026-28 brochure: '2 year full-time AICTE-approved Program (180 seats)'. Up to 5% of sanctioned intake under TFW scheme. Separate Mumbai PGDM programmes (E-Business, Research & Business Analytics, Retail, Media & Entertainment, Healthcare, Rural) have their own seats.
programs.placementNote: Placement Facts (2023-2025) in the PGDM 2026-28 brochure: median INR 11.78 LPA, average INR 11.70 LPA, maximum INR 40 LPA. (2022-24: median 11.48, average 12.26, max 22 LPA.) No 2024-26 PGDM final report found on the official site; no audit stated.

selectionProcess.name: Application and shortlisting
selectionProcess.detail: Shortlist for the online selection process on entrance-exam cut-off percentile (CAT/XAT/GMAT/ATMA/CMAT), plus profile-based shortlist for candidates awaiting CMAT results (who must later meet the cut-off). Minimum 50% in graduation.

selectionProcess.name: Pre-Interview Questionnaire and Personal Interview
selectionProcess.detail: Profile-based process that also values academics, work experience and group activity.

selectionProcess.name: Composite merit list
selectionProcess.detail: Entrance 35%, academics (10th, 12th, graduation) 15%, PIQ + interview 45%, extracurriculars 5%.

selectionWeightage.note: Listed as 'Weightage of parameters for final selection' on the current PGDM page; the page does not state the batch year.

officialCutoffs.note: Mumbai PGDM (also PGDM E-Business, PGDM RBA): 80 percentile in CAT 2025 / XAT 2026 / GMAT (2023 onwards).
Listed under 'ATMA Feb 2026 / CMAT 2026' column; page header says 'Score' but value appears to be a percentile.

keyDates.notes: PGDM 2027-29 application portal is live (pgdm2027-29.welingkar.org) but the site does not publish 2027-29 dates.
